00078 void PlayBufUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00079 { 
00080   const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00081     
00082   double channelBufferPos;
00083   
00084   for(int channel = 0; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
00085   {
00086     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00087     const int bufferSize = buffer_.size();
00088     channelBufferPos = bufferPos;
00089     float* outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00090     float* rateSamples = inputs[Rate].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00091     float* trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00092     float* offsetSamples = inputs[Offset].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00093     float* loopSamples = inputs[Loop].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00094         
00095     while(numSamplesToProcess ) 
00096     {       
00097       float thisTrig = *trigSamples++;
00098       
00099       if(thisTrig > 0.f && lastTrig <= 0.f)
00100         channelBufferPos = 0.0;
00101       
00102       double offset = *offsetSamples++;
00103       double position = offset + channelBufferPos;
00104       
00105       if(*loopSamples++ >= 0.5f) 
00106       {
00107         if(position >= bufferSize)
00108           position -= bufferSize;
00109         else if(channelBufferPos < 0)
00110           position += bufferSize;
00111         
00112         *outputSamples++ = buffer_.getSample(channel, position);
00113         channelBufferPos += *rateSamples++;
00114       
00115         if(channelBufferPos >= bufferSize)
00116           channelBufferPos -= bufferSize;
00117         else if(channelBufferPos < 0)
00118           channelBufferPos += bufferSize;
00119       }
00120       else
00121       {
00122         *outputSamples++ = buffer_.getSample(channel, position);
00123         channelBufferPos += *rateSamples++;
00124       }
00125       
00126       --numSamplesToProcess;
00127       lastTrig = thisTrig;
00128     }   
00129   }
00130   
00131   bufferPos = channelBufferPos;
00132   
00133   if(bufferPos >= buffer_.size())
00134   {
00135     shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00136     setIsDone();
00137   }
00138 }

00157 PlayBuf::PlayBuf(Buffer const& buffer, 
00158          UGen const& rate, 
00159          UGen const& trigger, 
00160          UGen const& startPos, 
00161          UGen const& loop, 
00162          const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00163 { 
00164   // just mix the input ugens, they should be mono
00165   // mix() will just return the original UGen if it has only one channel anyway
00166   
00167   const int numChannels = buffer.getNumChannels();
00168   
00169   if(numChannels > 0 && buffer.size() > 0)
00170   {
00171     initInternal(numChannels);
00172     
00173     UGen startPosChecked = startPos.mix();
00174     generateFromProxyOwner(new PlayBufUGenInternal(buffer, 
00175                              rate.mix(), 
00176                              trigger.mix(), 
00177                              startPosChecked, 
00178                              loop.mix(), 
00179                              doneAction));
00180 
00181     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00182     {
00183       internalUGens[i]->initValue(buffer.getSample(i, startPosChecked.getValue(0)));
00184     }
00185   } 
00186 }

00262 void RecordBufUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00263 {
00264   const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00265   
00266   int channelBufferPos;
00267   
00268   for(int channel = 0; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
00269   {
00270     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00271     const int bufferSize = buffer_.size();
00272     channelBufferPos = bufferPos;
00273     float* outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00274     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00275     float* preLevelSamples = inputs[PreLevel].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00276     float* recLevelSamples = inputs[RecLevel].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00277     float* loopSamples = inputs[Loop].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00278     float* bufferSamples = buffer_.getData(channel);
00279     
00280     while(numSamplesToProcess) 
00281     {                   
00282       if(*loopSamples++ >= 0.5f) 
00283       {
00284         if(channelBufferPos >= bufferSize)
00285           channelBufferPos = 0;
00286         
00287         float recLevel = *recLevelSamples++;
00288         float rec = *inputSamples++ * recLevel;
00289         float preLevel = *preLevelSamples++;
00290         float pre = bufferSamples[channelBufferPos] * preLevel;
00291         float out = pre + rec;
00292         *outputSamples++ = out;
00293         bufferSamples[channelBufferPos] = out;
00294         channelBufferPos++;
00295         
00296         if(channelBufferPos >= bufferSize)
00297           channelBufferPos = 0;
00298       }
00299       else
00300       {
00301         float rec = *inputSamples++ * *recLevelSamples++;
00302         float pre = bufferSamples[channelBufferPos] * *preLevelSamples++;
00303         float out = pre + rec;
00304         *outputSamples++ = out;
00305         bufferSamples[channelBufferPos] = out;
00306         channelBufferPos++;
00307       }
00308       
00309       --numSamplesToProcess;
00310     }   
00311   }
00312   
00313   bufferPos = channelBufferPos;
00314   
00315   if(bufferPos >= buffer_.size())
00316   {
00317     shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00318     setIsDone();
00319   } 
00320 }

00355 LoopPointsUGenInternal::LoopPointsUGenInternal(Buffer const& buffer, 
00356                          UGen const& rate, 
00357                          UGen const& start, 
00358                          UGen const& end,
00359                          UGen const& loop, 
00360                          UGen const& startAtZero,
00361                          UGen const& playToEnd) throw()
00362 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00363   b(buffer),
00364   currentValue((startAtZero.getValue() >= 0.5f) ? 0.f : start.getValue() * b.size()),
00365   lastLoop(false)
00366 {
00367   inputs[Rate] = rate;
00368   inputs[Start] = start;
00369   inputs[End] = end;
00370   inputs[Loop] = loop;
00371   inputs[StartAtZero] = startAtZero;
00372   inputs[PlayToEnd] = playToEnd;
00373 }

00375 void LoopPointsUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00376 {
00377   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00378   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00379   float* rateSamples = inputs[Rate].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00380   float* startSamples = inputs[Start].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00381   float* endSamples = inputs[End].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00382   float* loopSamples = inputs[Loop].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00383   float* startAtZeroSamples = inputs[StartAtZero].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00384   float* playToEndSamples = inputs[PlayToEnd].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00385   
00386   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00387   {
00388     float rate = *rateSamples;
00389     float start = *startSamples * b.size();
00390     float end = *endSamples * b.size();
00391     bool loop = *loopSamples >= 0.5f;
00392     
00393     if(start > end)
00394     {
00395       float temp = start;
00396       start = end;
00397       end = temp;
00398       rate = -rate;
00399     }
00400     
00401     currentValue += rate;
00402     
00403     if(loop)
00404     {            
00405       if((rate > 0.f) && (currentValue >= end))
00406       {
00407         if(lastLoop == false)
00408         {
00409           bool fromZero = *startAtZeroSamples >= 0.5f;
00410           
00411           currentValue = fromZero ? 0.f : start;
00412         }
00413         else
00414         {
00415           currentValue -= (end - start);
00416         }
00417       }
00418       else if((rate < 0.f) && (currentValue < start))
00419       {
00420         if(lastLoop == false)
00421         {
00422           bool fromEnd = *startAtZeroSamples >= 0.5f;
00423 
00424           currentValue = fromEnd ? (b.size()-1) : end;
00425         }
00426         else
00427         {            
00428           currentValue += (end - start);
00429         }
00430       }
00431     }
00432     else if(*playToEndSamples < 0.5f)
00433     {
00434       if((rate > 0.f) && (currentValue >= end))
00435       {
00436         currentValue = (float)b.size();
00437       }
00438       else if((rate < 0.f) && (currentValue < start))
00439       {
00440         currentValue = -1.f;
00441       }     
00442     }
00443     
00444     *outputSamples = currentValue;
00445     
00446     rateSamples++;
00447     startSamples++;
00448     endSamples++;
00449     loopSamples++;
00450     startAtZeroSamples++;
00451     playToEndSamples++;
00452     outputSamples++;
00453     
00454     lastLoop = loop;
00455   }
00456 }
